ترتقبين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقِبِينَ (tartaqibīna) /tar.ta.qi.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# تُرْتَقَبِينَ (turtaqabīna) /tur.ta.qa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
